# Use amd64 assembly and ELF symbol sizes; Mach-O and PE infer sizes
# from the distance to the next symbol.
[!GOARCH:amd64] skip
[!GOOS:linux] skip

# A BSS declaration must not replace Dupok TEXT, in either object order.
cp testdata/text.s a.s
cp testdata/bss.s b.s
go build -o main.exe
go tool nm -size main.exe
stdout ' 1 T target$'
cp testdata/bss.s a.s
cp testdata/text.s b.s
go build -o main.exe
go tool nm -size main.exe
stdout ' 1 T target$'

# Non-Dupok TEXT must also keep its size, not the larger BSS size.
replace 'DUPOK|' '' b.s
go build -o main.exe
go tool nm -size main.exe
stdout ' 1 T target$'

# When both definitions are Dupok, strict checking still diagnoses them.
cp testdata/text.s b.s
replace 'NOPTR' 'DUPOK|NOPTR' a.s
! go build -ldflags=-strictdups=2
stderr 'duplicate symbol .*target.*mismatched payload'
! stderr 'non-function sym|panic:'

-- go.mod --
module textbss

go 1.20
-- main.go --
package main

func addr() uintptr

func main() {
	println(addr())
}
-- addr_amd64.s --
#include "textflag.h"

TEXT ·addr(SB),NOSPLIT,$0-8
	LEAQ target(SB), AX
	MOVQ AX, ret+0(FP)
	RET
-- testdata/text.s --
#include "textflag.h"

TEXT target(SB),DUPOK|NOSPLIT,$0-0
	RET
-- testdata/bss.s --
#include "textflag.h"

GLOBL target(SB),NOPTR,$64
